statement_nl: Let s be any sign sequence whose count is maximal. By A13, its count must equal the maximal value E_n. Then A5 gives E_n = F(s) <= sum over j in V(s) of w_j, while A10 and A11 give sum over j in V(s) of w_j <= E_n. Hence sum over j in V(s) of w_j = E_n = max( sum over odd j of w_j, sum over even j of w_j ). The equality clause of L5 therefore forces V(s) to be exactly the set of odd positions in {1,...,n} or exactly the set of even positions in {1,...,n}.
